note: P is one idea four times: every poem is a nacreous, mother-of-pearl cloud that vanishes unseen, differing only in setting (veil, fjord, mountain) and ending. Q has three distinct takes (a twilight amber-and-blue streak under stars, a stationary lens cloud on a ridge, and a sunset mother-of-pearl edge) but Q3 and Q4 repeat the same ridge-sunset-mother-of-pearl image with different endings.
